explicit_validation.explanation: Both LLM and human evaluations are conducted but they are used independently without any comparison between the two methods. LLM evaluation focuses on dataset quality using GPT-4o on Connection, Quality, Information Density, and Friendliness criteria, while human evaluation focuses on model outputs using three trained research assistants on Faithfulness, Appropriateness, Naturalness, and Completeness criteria.

prompts.notes: Complete prompts for Connection, Quality, Information Density and Friendliness evaluations are detailed in Appendix Figures. The evaluation uses GPT-4o-2024-08-06 version.

guidelines.notes: Appendix provides definitions for evaluation criteria (Faithfulness, Appropriateness, Naturalness, Completeness) but full guidelines are not detailed beyond the criteria definitions.

criteria_mapping.notes: LLM evaluation focuses on dataset quality assessment while human evaluation focuses on model output quality assessment. There is no overlap in criteria between the two evaluation methods.
